scope.focus: subconscious learned idle-thought policy, reward/hallucination gate, PPO persistence and failure lineage

lineage.event: Introduced ~3.1M-parameter Actor-Critic learned idle-thought policy, PPO consolidation training, reward shaping, verified-memory pre-input gate, seven post-output hallucination checks, and hallucination penalty feedback.
32-bug audit fixed critical policy/training semantics including post-processing, spurious Jaccard penalties and action-mask omission during PPO training.

30-minute cybernetic observation found fallback choices were not recorded; 46% of decisions were lost to learning. Fixed by storing behavior-policy log-prob, state, mask and critic estimate for fallback actions.

Schema migration failure discovered: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS did not add mask column; record_transition silently failed on every call. Explicit PRAGMA/ALTER migration restored recording; four transitions verified in first three minutes.
SFT stabilizer added weight decay, reference anchoring, drift monitoring and gradient clipping to guard policy collapse/catastrophic forgetting.
20-category evolution exposed historical 19-vs-20 mask mismatch; loader now pads older masks with available=1.0 or truncates larger masks so old experience remains usable.

Frozen head is reduced to ~19K parameters with 20 categories, 100-dim state, CPU inference, stored action masks, PPO clipped objective, SFT anchor/health checks, atomic checkpointing and explicit cold-start exploration.

frozen_head_mechanism.cold_start: phased temperature/fallback schedule, then mature temperature 0.8 and zero fallback
frozen_head_mechanism.hallucination_penalty: -3.0 * hallucination_score plus extra penalty for multiple violations
frozen_head_mechanism.persistence: SQLite transition/history/hallucination/preference data plus atomic torch checkpoint
frozen_head_mechanism.stability: gradient clip, weight decay, reference-anchor loss, policy entropy/drift health monitoring

negative_results.result: Action mask not applied during PPO training although it constrained action selection.
negative_results.impact: Behavior-policy/training-policy mismatch invalidates PPO ratio semantics and can reinforce actions impossible in the sampled state.

negative_results.result: Fallback transitions were not recorded; 46% of decisions were absent from learner data.
negative_results.impact: Observed policy metrics represented a selected subset and could not learn from the dominant fallback behavior.

negative_results.result: Missing mask-column migration made record_transition fail silently on every call.
negative_results.impact: Service could appear healthy while online learning was completely inert.

negative_results.result: Category growth produced 19-vs-20 historical mask tensors.
negative_results.impact: Learner schema evolution requires explicit compatibility transforms; model/data versions cannot be assumed dimension-stable.

negative_results.result: Policy-collapse/catastrophic-forgetting risk required explicit anchor/decay/drift/gradient stabilization.
negative_results.impact: Small continuously trained policies need health shadows and last-known-good rollback, not loss-only promotion.

current_inheritance.delta: Historical evidence supports a tiny learned routing/policy head over compact state, but every selected action must carry availability mask, behavior-policy probability, provenance and an explicit fallback outcome.

Directly reuse schema-versioned replay-buffer lessons: examples/features/masks/class identities require compatibility metadata; learner health must distinguish no-data/no-op/silent-write-failure from successful training; candidate promotion needs retention/open-set shadows and rollback.
Regressionize missing transition columns, fallback-data omission, action-mask train/select mismatch, old-mask dimension migration, policy collapse and silent learning inactivity.

Persist transition schema/version, feature contract, action/class mask, behavior-policy probability, model version, reward components and outcome provenance atomically. Migrations must be explicit and tested on historical rows.
Learned idle policy may propose/select candidate cognitive work, never establish truth. Hallucination suppression and reward are behavior-control signals, not epistemic evidence.

Make policy-selection contracts typed: state_version, allowed_actions, selected_action, behavior_logprob, value_estimate, outcome, reward_components and model_version should be replayable first-class data.

reject_or_adapt: Do not treat stored reflection or positive mood movement as truth-quality reward.
Do not allow post-output hallucination score to become sole epistemic authority; it is one gate/penalty signal.
Do not use catch-and-log-debug around authoritative learner writes without a health invariant proving transitions are actually accumulating.
Do not assume new action/class categories are semantically available merely because old masks are padded with 1.0; migration policy needs per-category compatibility rules.
Do not equate training loss, entropy or service uptime with useful online learning.
cheap_discriminating_tests: Replay one trajectory with a forbidden action and assert selection and PPO training use the identical mask.
Force 50% fallback routing and assert every decision yields a transition with correct behavior-policy log-prob and outcome.
Remove a required transition column in a migration fixture and require startup/health to fail loudly before claiming learner-active.
Load N-action historical rows into N+1 schema and test explicit compatibility for each new action rather than unconditional availability.
Freeze policy weights while service stays healthy and assert learner health detects zero weight/data progression.
Inject reward-good but epistemically false generated content and assert truth/evidence stores remain unchanged.
